method: Capstone linear disassembly of MIR3.EXE .text (VA = file_offset + 0x400000); jump tables as raw dwords; GetKeyState scan in hotkey dispatcher; pefile IAT; cross-validated against F294 (guild 0x424E60 9-control array), F331 (skill book 0x439250/0x43A440/0x4397A0, ctor table), Round 28 F321 (caption action table), F329 (hotkey 0x42CBD0).

structure: iterate visible list: count [esi+0xD38], cursor [esi+0xD2C]; per node: id = [edi]
each entry: lea ecx,[esi+obj]; call PAINT_FN; lea eax,[esi+obj+0x18] (window rect +0x18)
id != 8: IntersectRect([0x476248], &[esp+0x10] viewport, &rect) -> if empty ebp=0 (skip mouse)
mouse dispatch: after render, if ebp!=0 -> jmp [0x7DA1C0/0x7DA1C4 mouse-pos-derived *4 + 0x428398] per-window mouse handler
0x428398 table: id0 -> 0x42FAB0 bag mouse; id1 -> 0x44B6B0 status mouse; id2 -> 0x44E650 store mouse; id3 -> 0x416790 trade mouse; id7 -> 0x450AC0 status mouse; others skip
after loop: mouse-pos dispatch 0x42AAB0 (Round 28) -> window id
